reviews.feedback: looks great but I think we should save as SVG and high-res PNG (like dpi = 900) as these are my preferred outputs to work with. I think the Recall label should have an n = #, like Recall (n = 461)

Unmatched is 1 line, while other labels (Same lineage, Same cell type) are two lines. the n = # lines are all aligned. But this means there is a space/blank line between Unmatched and its n = line. In the reference (Fig. 5b) this doesn't happen.
The PNG looks very high-res which is nice!
